# Weyland-Yutani Research Staff Handbook ## Colonial Laboratory Edition
[color=#a4885c]Weyland-Yutani Corporation, Research and Development Division. Research staff only. Sections marked RESTRICTED are need-to-know and may not be shared with anyone outside research staff, including other Company employees.[/color]
These are the policies and procedures for Company research staff at colonial sites. They apply in addition to the Employee Handbook. Where the two disagree, this handbook takes precedence.
Breaches of policy are recorded in the employee's personnel file. Breaches of confidentiality or containment may result in immediate dismissal.
[italic]Building Better Worlds.[/italic]
